keep.text: Poori duniya mein har taraf peptides, peptides ki lehar chal rahi hai.
Sab bolte hain peptides kha lo, koi bolte hain peptides laga lo, koi nahi batata ki peptides mein teen categories hain.
Log BPC-157, Ozempic, Sermorelin sabko ek hi basket mein daal dete hain. Peptides lekin alag-alag cheezein hain, alag evidence hai aur alag-alag risk bhi hai.
But sab log isko overcomplicate karke saari cheezein batate hain.
Ekdam simple tareeke se aaj peptides samjha raha hoon, achhe tareeke se samajh jaana, poori video zaroor dekhna.
Peptides ki teen different categories hain. Number one, GLP-1 agonists:
Ozempic,
Mounjaro, Retatrutide,
aur ye saari ki saari weight loss peptides hain.
Inke teen phases ke trials ho chuke hain, FDA approve bhi hone lagi hain kuch-kuch peptides,
aur
millions of patients ke upar
di jaane bhi lagi hain, proven ho chuka hai ki haan, ye kaam kar rahi hain.
Category number two: GH secretagogues,
ya Sermorelin, ya Ipamorelin, ya MK-677, ye saare ke saare growth hormone peptides hain, ye growth hormone ko badhaane waale peptides hain. Tesamorelin
FDA approved ho chuki hai
ek condition ke liye,
baaki research level pe hain.
Evidence abhi mixed type ke hain.

Category number three: recovery ke peptides alag aa chuke hain. BPC-157, TB-500, Wolverine stack isko kehte hain. Saare jo celebrities hain aaj ke time pe, saare TV pe, podcast pe aa karke isi peptide ke baare mein baat kar rahe hain, jo ki
abhi
research ekdam zero hai.
Do teen chhoti chhoti pilot studies hui hain inke upar, kuch
sau animals ke upar studies hui hain, evidence bahut kam hai.
Toh
ye category number three mein aati hai, jinko one star diya jaata hai. Category one ko
five star diya jaata hai, aur category two ko three star log dete hain.
Toh jin jin peptides ke evidence hain, usko FDA dheere dheere approve kar rahi hai.
Jin jin peptides ka
koi bhi evidence abhi achhe tareeke se nahi aaya hai, ya bahut saare trials nahi hue, toh usko FDA approve abhi nahi kar paayi hai.
Ab log isse bahut shor macha rahe hain ki Tesamorelin is the best peptide to
lose weight.
Abhi abhi koi naya research aaya hua hai jismein Lilly ne bola hua hai, jo Tesamorelin, GLP-1 aur in saari cheezon ki baat karti thi, ya inki company ne peptide ko introduce karaya tha,
unhone kaha hai ki Retatrutide
is the best peptide, ye GLP-1 ka do guna tezi se kaam kar rahi hai, jisse aap logon ka weight aur tezi se
lose ho jaayega.
Ab peptides ko market is tareeke se kiya ja raha hai ki log
ye soche samjhe bina ki
isse kya
harm hoga body ko,
kuch aisi peptides hain jo research purpose ke liye hain, uske baad bhi log apne aapko lagaaye ja rahe hain.
Toh
ye poori ki poori irony samajhne waali hai:
jo sabse popular hai Instagram pe, uska sabse weak
evidence hai,
aur jo actually proven hai, uske baare mein toh log baat hi karna nahi chahte hain.
Ab
India mein bahut saari peptides abhi fake bik rahi hain,
toh India se peptide lena impossible hai, aap log yahan se toh kabhi mat peptide lijiyega.
But
main aap logon ko bata raha hoon,
Elevate Now,
Sugar Fit, ye saare ke saare peptides bech rahe hain.
Ye jo aap logon ko keh rahe hain ki
injection laga karke aap log
blood test kara lo,
toh

at the end of the day ye aap logon ko GLP-1 ya Tesamorelin bechne ki koshish karenge. Sugar Fit bhi yahi karega. Kyun? Kyunki ye bataayenge ki FDA approved hai, toh aap injection lagakar patle ho sakte ho.
But
agar aap logon ko ye saari cheezein karni hain, toh doctor ki nigraani mein kariyega,
achhe doctor ki nigraani mein karein, jisko pata ho ki peptides kis tareeke se kaam karein.
Peptides ka poora protocol hota hai, iski bhi cycle chalti hai, toh ye aap logon ko samajhna padega.
Peptides steroids nahi hain. Peptides ke upar main poori kahaani, poori
achhe tareeke se samjha doonga aap logon ko ek naye video mein.
But aaj ke time pe main aap logon ko science samjha raha hoon.
Toh mera kaam tha science pahunchana, decision aapka hai. You are watching FitFinfluencer, milte hain
next video mein!
